description: List the new postings the person's job alerts have matched — the same matches their alerts are built from, newest first, still-open postings only. Narrow to one alert by id, and to a window by since (RFC 3339) or days (default 7, max 30). An alert only matches postings that appeared after it was created, and matching runs every few minutes, so a new one starts empty. delivered says whether an alert already carried the posting.

days.description: Look back this many days (default 7, max 30). Ignored when since is given.

id.description: One alert's id; omit for all.

since.description: Only matches recorded at or after this RFC 3339 time.

name: subscription_updates
